release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.24 expands the standard-member live announcement experience into the shell space reclaimed by the hard member-versus-owner build split. Public member builds already physically exclude Owner Vault and the private Owner announcement composer; this release now uses their former combined footprint instead of leaving the member announcement surface constrained to one old Vault card. In Top/Classic layout, the member announcement bar expands from 252px to the former combined 514px Owner Vault + Owner Hub footprint and now shows the latest announcement message preview alongside its title. In Sidebar layout, the member announcement surface expands from the old 112px Vault footprint to a 298px minimum rail using the space formerly consumed by Vault + owner composer, with a larger multi-line preview and direct announcement-center affordance. The click-through Member Announcements center expands from 620px to 760px with roomier rows and text, while collapsed Sidebar remains compact. The entire expansion is guarded by the build audience, so private Owner builds keep their existing Owner Vault + Owner Announcements Hub layout unchanged. Member Build Boundary was strengthened to scan the exact compiled member EXE and require the expanded-announcements marker while simultaneously rejecting Owner Vault and the private Owner updater markers. PR #336 passed Architecture Guard, Linux Release Preflight including UI/DOM/source/race/vulnerability gates, Owner Windows Consumer E2E with real Wails/WebView2, Member Windows E2E with real Wails/WebView2 plus exact compiled-artifact proof of no Owner Vault/no private Owner updater/yes expanded member announcements, and both Go and JavaScript/TypeScript CodeQL high-severity gates before merge.
